message.content:
An editorial illustration on a magazine cover features a tan-skinned man with dark hair, wearing a brown suit and a striped tie. His hands rest on a desk in the foreground, with a gold ring on his left ring finger. Behind him, two empty orange executive chairs are depicted in separate frames. In front of the man on the desk lies a document with a fan-shaped arrangement of red and orange labels.

The cover features the large white word "TEMPO" at the top. Above it, text reads "DI BALIK PENGGANTIAN DIREKSI BULOG / SIAPA MENGATUR SKOR SEA GAMES". Below the title is "22-28 JUNI 2015". Centered across the man is the large white text "KURSI-KURSI MENTERI YUDDY". Below this, smaller white text states, "Pelbagai tudingan mengarah kepadanya. Dari mengatur penetapan pejabat eselon satu sampai mengirim katebelece yang tak patut." The bottom right corner contains a price of "RP 39.500", a website URL, and a barcode with the numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00017".
